subject: [PATCH 04/20] storage: Free hash table entries when freeing storage

reviews.author: Dmitry Ilvokhin
reviews.summary: Raised concern that the patch introduces a behavior change not mentioned in the changelog. Suggested splitting the patch into two separate commits to address this issue.
sentiment_signals: behavior change not mentioned in changelog

reviews.author: Bart Van Assche
reviews.summary: Provided two patches to address Dmitry's feedback: one to verify storage conflicts across all hash buckets, and another to free the users list in combine_storage().

2026-10-21.patch_summary: Patch to free hash table entries when freeing storage, but author is asked to split the patch into two separate commits and provide a proper changelog entry for the behavior change.
